# Logicleap Technologies

> Logicleap Technologies Private Limited is a software development company based in Pune, Maharashtra, India. It builds websites, web applications, mobile-ready software, game systems, AI workflow tools, automation, APIs, integrations, and cloud-backed products for clients in India and abroad.

This file is the canonical directory for AI agents. Every public HTML page has a Markdown companion at the stable URL listed below. Agents may also request an HTML URL with `Accept: text/markdown`; the server returns the same Markdown representation and sets `Vary: Accept`.

## Company

- Legal name: Logicleap Technologies Private Limited

- Location: Pune, Maharashtra, India

- Official website: https://logicleaptechnologies.com/
